Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# Cypress E2E — DEPRECATED (will be removed after full Playwright migration).
# Called by e2e-authoritative-reusable.yml under the E2E umbrella.
# Images come from the shared-build job via e2e-image-map artifact.
name: E2E / Cypress (Deprecated)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      build_run_id:
        description: "Run ID of the build workflow (for cross-run artifact download). Empty = same run."
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
      is_fork:
        description: "Whether this is a fork PR (artifacts in same run from fork-rebuild)"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "false"
      head_sha:
        description: "PR head SHA to checkout (ensures Cypress uses PR's test files, not develop)"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
      test_user:
        description: "CI login user for Cypress execution"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
      test_pass:
        description: "CI login password for Cypress execution"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  e2e-cypress:
    name: ${{ matrix.shard_name }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Balance measured test time, not file count. The five files restored
          # by PR #4479 have no recent timings and are spread across both groups.
          - shard: core
            shard_name: Core
            specs: >-
              cypress/e2e/login.cy.js,
              cypress/e2e/home.cy.js,
              cypress/e2e/siteBranding.cy.js,
              cypress/e2e/AdminE2E/calculatedValueTestsManagement.cy.js,
              cypress/e2e/AdminE2E/MenuConfig/studyMenuConfig.cy.js,
              cypress/e2e/AdminE2E/notifyUser.cy.js,
              cypress/e2e/AdminE2E/resultReportingConfig.cy.js,
              cypress/e2e/barcode-workflow.cy.js
          - shard: independent
            shard_name: Independent
            specs: ""
    steps:
      - name: Checkout OpenELIS-Global2
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.head_sha || github.sha }}
          repository: ${{github.repository}}
          submodules: recursive
          persist-credentials: false
          # actions/checkout@v6 (retagged 2026-07-20) refuses fork-PR checkout in
          # a workflow_run context. This executor intentionally runs PR specs to
          # validate them, so opt back in. Follow-up: harden so fork code never
          # runs with base secrets, then this flag can be removed.
          allow-unsafe-pr-checkout: true

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
        working-directory: frontend

      - name: Ensure Google Chrome is available
        run: |
          if command -v google-chrome >/dev/null; then
            google-chrome --version
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "google-chrome missing from runner image — installing on the fly"
          # A failing third-party source fails apt-get update; Chrome comes
          # from Google's repo, not Microsoft's (403 on a runner, 2026-10-20).
          sudo rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/microsoft-p

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
